feeds.title: Taste of Country
feeds.description: Read the latest country music news from your favorite country music stars. Country music is served fresh daily at Taste of Country.

feeds.title: Lightning 100
feeds.description: Nashville's independent radio, an advocate of local music and businesses for more than 30 years! Get the latest coverage of news, interviews, albums release and more from Nashville music industry.

feeds.title: Nashville Music Guide
feeds.description: Nashville Music Guide Magazine has been publicizing Singers, Musicians, and Writers to music row and beyond since 1995. NMG has become the most widely read music magazine in Music City. Best of all, NMG doesn't just promote & write about the tiny number of artists & writers who have major-label deals or staff songwriter contracts. It has always helped the thousands of lesser-known Nashville singers, players & writers with little recognition.

feeds.title: Nashville Lifestyles » Music
feeds.description: Since 1999, Nashville Lifestyles magazine has served as the authority on all things Nashville. As the only paid publication on the market, Nashville Lifestyles engages a diverse readership of over 120,000+ people each month. Get the latest on music in the city of Nashville with updates on shows, concerts, artists and more!

feeds.title: Nashville Music Line
feeds.description: This blog will provide news, ideas and inspiration for singers and songwriters, particularly those of you just starting out on your career path. I provide career development advice and guidance for people like you, and - in the case of younger singer-songwriters - for parents as well.

feeds.title: Music Mecca
feeds.description: Music Mecca is a Nashville-based music blog featuring artist interviews, reviews, playlist curations, & more. Find new music here.

feeds.title: Nashville.com » Music
feeds.description: Get the latest news and inside information about the Nashville music scene from Nashville.com. Owned by the Castello Brothers, and operated by the Castello Cities Internet Network, Nashville.com is the worldwide brand and essential guide for Nashville.

feeds.title: East of 8th Music Blog
feeds.description: East of 8th covers all things in the indie and alternative music scene. Based out of Nashville, Tennessee, follow us for album and concert reviews, music festival coverage, music news, and curated playlists.

feeds.title: The Boot
feeds.description: The Boot celebrates country music's biggest stars of yesterday and today through breaking news, artist exclusives and daily fan-engagement features. The top source for the latest country music news, videos, songs, interviews and live performances from country's biggest stars.

feeds.title: Nashville Unsigned Podcast
feeds.description: Your source for Music City's top independent artist curation. Featuring interviews, live events, music news, videos and more Join the Movement Live Unsigned.

feeds.title: MusicRow Magazine
feeds.description: For more than 40 years MusicRow magazine's publications have been at the forefront of the Nashville music industry. Known for its candid voice and accuracy, music executives rely on the outlet for exclusive reviews, breaking news, and in-depth coverage.

feeds.title: Country Now
feeds.description: Country Now offers fans extensive coverage of the country music genre. Featuring breaking news, artist interviews, exclusive, multi-platform content, and much more, Country Now is quickly becoming a go-to online destination for country music fans.

feeds.title: Nashville Insider » Country Music
feeds.description: Nashville Insider is a fast-paced syndicated country music entertainment news series with new episodes airing each week. We go behind the scenes to provide access to fans' favorite artists and country music's hottest events. We deliver the latest in trending headlines and social media. We provide up-to-the-minute reporting, making Nashville Insider the go-to source for country music news and information, and the only TV series of its kind from the heart of Music City.

feeds.title: Nashville Rocks
feeds.description: Music News Blog dedicated to comprehensively covering independent music and artists in the Mid-South. Nashville Rocks is a music entertainment website. We offer entertainment news from major artists, independents, and the music business that supports the industry and the fans.

feeds.title: Charlie Rogers Blog
feeds.description: Blogs featuring the latest news, updates, sneak peeks, and personal musings from Charlie Rogers. Discover his upcoming and recently released music, travel blogs, and more. Charlie Rogers is an Oregon-born, Kansas-raised genre-alchemizing country singer-songwriter based out of Nashville, TN.

feeds.title: Country Countdown USA
feeds.description: Country Countdown USA.com announces and recounts each week's special guest along with Lon Helton on the show where they share funny, unrehearsed stories from their Country music careers. Lon Helton Nashville insider, well-known by the stars, and a known personality around the Country music scene.

feeds.title: Nashville Scene » Music
feeds.description: Read featured articles, music events, reviews, and the latest collaborations among artists in the city. From investigative cultural and political reporting to looks inside the city's massive arts and entertainment industry, the Scene is a must-read newsweekly for Nashvillians providing critical analysis and daily coverage.

feeds.title: FreeCCM
feeds.description: View Christian Music News and Archived articles. FreeCCM is the benchmark source for free and legal Christian music downloads, behind the scenes updates, video interviews, contests, and more. Our website allows fans access to Christian music news, contests and free downloads every week.

feeds.title: Twangville
feeds.description: Twangville is a Music Review blog featuring Alt-Country, Americana, Indie, Rock, Folk & Blues. Emphasizing the Alt side of Alt-country, we cover releases, reviews, downloads, links, and more. Explore Reader's Picks, Artist interviews, and more in our latest posts.

feeds.title: Think Country
feeds.description: Discover Music reviews, Interviews, Featured articles on local stories, and more music news content. Bridging the gap between fans and country artists, Think Country is a one-stop shop to read the latest news from country music in the UK and USA, reviews, and interviews.

feeds.title: That Nashville Sound
feeds.description: That Nashville Sound by Ken Morton, Jr is a blog about country music and its culture. Ken writes and discusses Music Reviews, Artist Interviews, and His Top 10 lists, and shares New Music videos from local artists focusing on country music. Ken is an author, songwriter, blogger, music critic, and the founder of Golf & Guitars.

feeds.title: American Songwriter
feeds.description: American Songwriter brings you interviews, songwriting tips, news, reviews and lyric contests, business insight, blogs, and online exclusive content for aspiring or professional songwriters and serious music enthusiasts. American Songwriter is a bimonthly magazine, established in 1984 covering every aspect of the craft and art of songwriting.

feeds.title: SpitMad Blog
feeds.description: Check out the latest music news, publications, interviews, and reviews from a range of genres including Alternative, Pop, Bluegrass, and Country-folk to name a few in the SpitMad blog. We are a growing community of music lovers and strive to help market Independent music creators and connect artists across the globe.

feeds.title: CMA World
feeds.description: Stay updated on all the latest news and events from CMA, delivering all trending news, programs, and efforts on engaging new talent. Founded in 1958, the Country Music Association (CMA) is the premier trade association of the Country Music industry and globally represents professionals making a living in Country Music.

feeds.title: Music City Music Magazine
feeds.description: Music City Music Magazine covers local bands and touring artists playing in the USA. Featuring the best in live photos, interviews, artist videos, the latest and upcoming music festivals across the country, and more. Catch unmissable show timings, schedules, and other cool stuff about your favorite bands.

feeds.title: 92Q Nashville News
feeds.description: Feed posts from 92Q Nashville News focusing on R&B and Throwbacks - Grab the latest scoops, hot topics, controversies, and more. 92Q Nashville is a local radio station owned by Cumulus Media especially broadcasting R&B Music, local news, and more.

feeds.title: Nashville Music Equality
feeds.description: A community of people committed to minimizing the equality gap that exists within the music industry in Nashville. NME's mission is to create an anti-racist environment in the Nashville Music Industry by providing community, education, mentorship, & resources for the Music Community.

feeds.title: Music Lab Nashville Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about our school, education, news, updates, our industry, best practices, and so much more. Music Lab Nashville serves the Nashville, Brentwood, and Franklin areas for music lessons. We offer drum, guitar, bass guitar, piano, voice, violin, ukulele, saxophone, clarinet, flute, and trumpet lessons from the highest quality instructors in the area.

feeds.title: FOCUS on the 615 » Music
feeds.description: Nashville's premier entertainment blog including album, song and show reviews and exclusive artist interviews. Focus on the 615 has been a Premier music, lifestyle & travel site bringing best from Nashville & beyond since 2011.

feeds.title: Sony Music Nashville News
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with News, News releases, Music, and more with Sony Music Nashville News, providing the latest stories and breaking headlines in Country Music. Sony Music Nashville, part of Sony Music Entertainment, finds, nurtures, and represents some of the most influential and emergent musical talents in Nashville.

feeds.title: New Roots Nashville Blog
feeds.description: Discover tips & resources, and best practices from industry experts in this blog focused on female artists. NEW ROOTS is a boutique, action-packed artist experience that provides artists with practical resources to develop a new generation of passionate, empowered young women.

feeds.title: Nashville Unsigned
feeds.description: Discover New Music, Upcoming Shows, Artist Interviews, and more informative stuff. Nashville Unsigned is a hub for budding, independent musiciansand features Nashville's rising independent talent. We also host live events for musicians and other music industry professionals to network.

feeds.title: Full Circle Music Blog
feeds.description: The Full Circle Music Blog is a complete resource offering great insights and career-building tips for individuals in the Music Industry. Discover essential know-how, simple tricks for writing songs, and more. Full Circle Music is a music company that specializes in creating hit songs with top creators in Nashville and the industry at large.

feeds.title: Nashville Guitar Guru Blog
feeds.description: Nashville Guitar Guru, Dave Isaacs, offers private acoustic and electric guitar lessons, music theory lessons, teaching blogs, articles, and videos to help all players, songwriters, and performers be better musicians. Check out the latest posts for more technical and musical insight aimed at bettering your skills.

feeds.title: NashvilleGab
feeds.description: NashvilleGab is a website dedicated to country music and country music fans with a sense of humor. We thrive on bringing you the stories that no one else has and we enjoy the fun side of music. Most importantly, we never take ourselves too seriously. If you like your country music news brought to you with a side of humor and a big ol' helping of sass, then NashvilleGab is for you.

feeds.title: Nashville Music Academy Blog
feeds.description: Nashville Music Academy offers in-home music lessons and workshops for any age and every instrument. Learn more about our programs for individuals with special needs in this blog alongside information on Music History, Special announcements, Silly musings, and facts concerning Classical music.

feeds.title: Main Street Nashville
feeds.description: Browse our daily updated coverage of the musical scene in Nashville, spotlighting emergent local talent, music shows, events, and more. Main Street Nashville is a local news source in Nashville providing sharp and interrupted reporting of Tennesse News, Local Communities, Sports, and Opinions.

feeds.title: Underground Music Collective » Nashville Music Blog
feeds.description: Underground Music Collective is a fiscally sponsored project of the Arts & Business Council of Greater Nashville, a nonprofit organization. Get the latest updates and news from Nashville music industry.

feeds.title: Stringjoy Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Stringjoy Guitar blog for more info, tips, & tricks on how to capture the sound you're looking for out of your guitar or bass guitar. Stringjoy is a boutique guitar string company located in Music City and dedicated to making the highest quality guitar and bass strings, providing the best customer service in the industry.

feeds.title: Venture Music Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog page packed with informative marketing tips and insightful strategies for the music & entertainment industry. Venture Music is a marketing collective created for the modern music industry that specializes in custom-built marketing plans that help our clients reach and engage their fans across the digital landscape.
